notes.title: Star Gun version 1.1 update
notes.notes: [p]This update introduces Mission Mutators and expands the Ship Upgrade system aiming to make missions even more dynamic and each ship more customizable.[/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Mission Mutators[/b]: Missions now has a chance to include a random mutator, altering gameplay in unique ways. Mutators begin to appear in the middle of the first sector. Note: does not affect pre-v1.1 save files. [/p][/*][*][p][b]15 New Ship Upgrades[/b]: Expanding the current roster from 37 to 52, these upgrades offer more options, utility, and specialization for your ship.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Nullwave Shield: Now blocks all damage for 1 second after triggering, rather than only the triggering DMG instance.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss HP: Reduced by ~5% in the last three sectors.[/p][/*][*][p]Freezing Modifier: Credit cost increased by 50%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Additional options:[/h3][list][*][p]Option to not highlight newly unlocked equipment (the '!') added to gameplay options.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to turn off mouse movement (i.e., option to use only mouse buttons).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed crash occurring when starting certain levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug of missions being slightly longer than intended. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated font for collected loot display.[/p][/*][*][p]Laser damage now properly counted toward certain achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small memory leak during space levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Negative energy regeneration no longer drops energy below 0.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes applied to mouse control behavior.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
